text:
alexa-partners: Hey team — incoming hardware partner (EdgeWave) wants to list a gateway in the cloud marketplace. Marketplace requires firmware notarization + attestation artifacts. Can we map out the minimal package and a presign/upload plan?

sam-security: Thanks. We need: SOC2 summary (or link), latest pen-test report (redacted), firmware signing chain (certs + signatures), SBOM, and a chain-of-custody attestation PDF.

carmen-eng: For firmware signing chain, do they mean raw signatures or a notarized timestamp? Some marketplaces want an external notarization stamp.

ben-hw: EdgeWave here — we can provide a timestamped signature from our signer CA, plus the sigs for each firmware build. We also have an HSM attestation report. How should we package?

ellie-ps: Prefer a single tarball per release + an index.json that lists files and checksums. Also need instructions for redaction rules for the pen-test PDF.

sam-security: Redaction rules: remove internal IPs, customer names, but keep summary of vuln severity + remediation status. We need a curator to approve redaction before upload.

alexa-partners: Proposal: 1) EdgeWave prepares attestation tarball 2) upload to our secure ingest S3 with short-lived presigned URL 3) security reviews redacted pen report 4) we hand off artifact bundle to marketplace. Timeline aim: 2 weeks. Thoughts?

carmen-eng: Ops note — default presign TTL is 7d, can be shortened. For automated ingest we support multipart upload with a presign for initiate + part PUTs. Example presign flow:

```
# generate presigned POST for direct upload
aws s3 presign put-object --bucket redwood-partner-ingest --key edgewave/attest-v1.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
```

ops-bot: FYI: presign TTL 86400s set for partner ingest bucket per current policy. Manual override requires ops approval.

ben-hw: 7 days ok. Can we get a template/manifest? We'll fill and upload.

ellie-ps: I'll seed a manifest template. Minimal manifest fields: vendor, release_tag, sha256 for each artifact, signer_cert_chain (PEM), signature_files, sbom_link, soc2_summary_link, pen_test_redacted_link, chain_of_custody_pdf. Also include contact and redaction_approver.

sam-security: Add: attestations must include KMS key identifier used for signing or HSM cert metadata. If HSM, include witness log.

alexa-partners: Capturing action items: - Ben/EdgeWave: create attestation tarball + manifest (owner: ben-hw) - Carmen: confirm presign workflow & TTL change path (owner: carmen-eng) - Sam: redaction checklist + reviewer slot (owner: sam-security) - Ellie: upload manifest template + S3 prefix and instructions (owner: ellie-ps)

ben-hw: Will start today, aim to upload initial bundle by 1718507000.

carmen-eng: If they need TTL >7d for large uploads, tag with `presign-long` and ping me. Otherwise stick to default.

sam-security: Quick Q: Do we accept third-party notarization services (e.g., timestamping from NotaryCorp)? If yes, need chain of trust proof.

alexa-partners: Marketplace prefers an external timestamp but accepts internal CA if we provide cross-cert + audit log. Ben is using an HSM-backed signer, so provide logs.

ops-bot: Upload bucket: s3://redwood-partner-ingest/edgewave/  Presign policy: max 86400s. Audit log will capture uploader identity.

ellie-ps: I uploaded manifest template to drive: https://drive.redwood/edgewave-manifest-template — use `manifest-v1.json` schema.

ben-hw: Thanks — starting work. Will ping when presign requested.

sam-security: I'll schedule a 30m review window for the pen-report redaction on Friday.

alexa-partners: Great — I'll coordinate marketplace listing owner once artifacts are approved. :thumbsup:
